title: Production Odds Coverage Activation — Dual Provider Audit + Canary

pull_request.blocker: GitHub CLI is not installed in the execution environment.

root_cause.summary: The 97 due checkpoint fixture IDs were sent to odds synchronization before production-whitelist filtering. Ninety-three were unsupported. The four supported fixtures had no Odds-API.io provider-event match, so /odds/multi was never called. The existing composite provider also treated an empty or partial primary result as success, so The Odds API fallback was not called.

production_97_fixture_funnel.fixture_level_reason_codes: All 97 fixture IDs and reason codes are listed in the Markdown report appendix.

fallback_semantics: primary empty for eligible fixture -> fallback
primary partial batch -> fallback only missing fixtures
primary valid complete coverage -> no fallback
data_integrity: provider_source and provider_event_id are retained on snapshots
Bet365 feed variants normalize to one canonical bookmaker identity
implementation.schema_change: New pending Alembic revision 0021 adds nullable provider provenance columns and an index. It was tested only on a disposable database and has not been applied to production.

canary.blocker: Production is at Alembic 0020. Snapshot provenance requires 0021 and therefore a production-clone reconciliation/rehearsal plus explicit Production Database Approval before any production snapshot-write canary.

tests.integration_note: The first Windows run hit pre-existing TEMP permission errors; the worktree-local basetemp rerun passed 103/103.
tests.alembic_check: passed at 0021 before and after rollback rehearsal

recommended_rollout: Review this code and migration in a PR without merging.
Perform the mandatory production-clone rehearsal for migration 0021, including schema diff, rollback and repeated rehearsal.
Obtain explicit Production Database Approval before applying 0021.
After migration and deployment approval, run a maximum-five-fixture production canary, then stop for rollout approval.
approval_gate: STOP. No merge, production migration, deployment, Windows task change or bulk execution is authorized.
